{"predictors": [
  {"name": "Inventory Change Rate", "construction": "Change in inventory (Compustat item INV) over the past year divided by average total assets (AT) over the same period.", "rationale": "Firms aggressively building inventories may be overoptimistic about future sales, leading to subsequent corrections.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Short-Term Debt Surge", "construction": "Growth in short-term debt (DLC) over the prior fiscal year, scaled by total assets (AT).", "rationale": "Sudden increases in short-term debt may signal financial distress or impending dilution.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "R&D Intensity Change", "construction": "Change in R&D expenditure (XRD) as a percent of sales (SALE), over the past two fiscal years.", "rationale": "Increasing R&D intensity may indicate management’s confidence in future growth and innovation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Unusual Accruals", "construction": "Total accruals (change in current assets (ACT) minus change in current liabilities (LCT) minus depreciation (DP)) divided by average total assets (AT) over the prior year.", "rationale": "High accruals can indicate earnings management, which may foreshadow future underperformance.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Dividend Initiation", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to one if a firm initiates a cash dividend (DV) in the past year and zero otherwise.", "rationale": "Dividend initiations may signal management confidence in stable future cash flows.", "higher_returns_for": "firms that have just initiated a dividend"},
  {"name": "Sales Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly sales (SALE) growth rates over the past three years.", "rationale": "Lower sales volatility may reflect stable operations and less uncertainty about future earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Management Share Purchases", "construction": "Net insider buying: number of insider share purchases minus insider sales over the prior year, as reported in SEC filings, scaled by shares outstanding.", "rationale": "Net buying by management may indicate undervaluation or positive private information.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Operating Lease Commitments", "construction": "Operating lease expense (as reported in footnotes) divided by total assets (AT).", "rationale": "High off-balance-sheet lease commitments may signal hidden leverage and risk.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Retained Earnings Ratio", "construction": "Retained earnings (RE) divided by total equity (CEQ) at fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "A high ratio suggests a track record of profitability and prudent reinvestment.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Segment Diversification Discount", "construction": "Number of distinct business segments reported in annual filings minus industry average, normalized by firm size.", "rationale": "Firms more diversified than their peers may suffer from a 'conglomerate discount' due to complexity and lack of focus.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
